name: APARTM.INV. MGMT A DL-,01
summary: APARTM.INV. MGMT A DL-,01 refers to Apartment Income REIT (AIR), a real estate investment trust (REIT). AIR focuses on the ownership, management, and redevelopment of apartment communities in the United States. The company aims to deliver attractive risk-adjusted returns to its shareholders through rental income and property appreciation.
